column1: # gpu/kernels/registry.tsv: model kernels per device target (docs/OMEGA-PACKAGE.md "Kernels").
# SHAPE: any (the kernel takes its sizes at run time), or the fixed shape it was written for.
# TARGET: cpu (built for the CPU omega runs on), spirv-cl, amd-gfx942. A device whose target has no
# row for an op (every nvidia-sm121 op: its generators have no stdin/stdout entry point yet) is skipped
# with its reason and the next target in the device's order is used, ending at cpu.
# BUILD and INPUT (paths under the package's share/ directory):
#   omc         INPUT = parts concatenated in order, compiled by lib/CPU/omc for this CPU
#   spirv-emit  INPUT = arguments of lib/CPU/spirv-emit (gpu/spirv/emit.om); stdout is the module
#   amd-hsaco   INPUT = the instruction table given to lib/CPU/amd-hsaco (gpu/amd/gfx942/hsaco.om)
# CHECK, run on every build before the kernel enters the cache:
#   elf                             ELF64, executable, e_machine of this CPU
#   spirv ENV K NIN NWORK NOUT      spirv-val --target-env ENV, kernel-check load SPIRV_CL, then the
#                                   host executor spirv-run on conform's inputs, bit for bit against
#   targets FORMAT ARG              kernel-check load FORMAT kernel ARG must print LOAD ACCEPT
# None of these checks runs a GPU: a GPU target's kernel is checked on the host (HOST_TESTED);
# device execution is NOT_RUN until a receipt from that device exists.
